title: Yuuyuu No Tsuihou Mahou Tsukai To Osananajimi Na Mori No Megami-sama
description: Although Lute is a rare user of green magic, his ability is not recognized and he is expelled from the prestigious Vedele Royal Academy of Magic as incompetent.. “There is more than one way to support the kingdom.”. Thinking so, Lute decides to support the country with agriculture that utilizes green magic in his hometown of Portos Village.. How will Lute's magic, which has become more and more powerful after training at the academy, change the village?
author: kaede7
